selection_rule: on dev seed 500, score = mean(addressing over {G1,G2,G3,G4,G5,G7}) - max(0, nomatch_false_accept - 0.30), subject to determinism_ok and leakage all_pass; argmax; tie-break lower nomatch_false_accept, then fewer steps; winner frozen as config.SELECTED and asserted by run_dev_selection.py
seed_disjointness: final cohort disjoint from V100 seeds [28-32], dev seeds [500-502], and burned seeds
no_match_primary_mechanism: learned_null_key (not replaceable by margin thresholding; not selected after viewing reserved results)
